# Kampa

> Kampa is a free AI campaign planner for small businesses. It interviews you
> in eight questions — what you sell, who buys it, your budget, your hours —
> then builds a complete 30-day marketing campaign: channel plan with the
> rejections explained, budget split, weekly calendar, and ready-to-paste copy.
> The software is free and open source; you bring your own Claude API key and
> pay Anthropic roughly €1 per campaign. It is a static site with no backend:
> everything runs in your browser and the only network call it makes is to
> api.anthropic.com.

## Pages

- [/](/): Landing page — what Kampa builds, how it works, how it compares to
  ChatGPT and paid tools, FAQ.
- [/app](/app): The planner itself — the 8-question interview and the generated
  30-day campaign. Runs entirely client-side with your own API key.
- [/samples](/samples): Index of three complete sample campaign plans.
- [/samples/riga-coffee-shop](/samples/riga-coffee-shop): 30-day plan for an
  owner-run specialty coffee shop in Riga — €400/month, 4 hours a week,
  Instagram + Google Business Profile + email.
- [/samples/hair-salon](/samples/hair-salon): 30-day plan for a two-chair hair
  salon in Jelgava — €250/month, 3 hours a week, filling the midweek chairs.
- [/samples/ecommerce-boutique](/samples/ecommerce-boutique): 30-day plan for a
  solo linen homeware boutique shipping across the EU — €700/month, 6 hours a
  week, Pinterest + email + Instagram.
- [/faq](/faq): What it costs, what you get, where your API key lives, whether
  it fits your business.
- [/guide/api-key](/guide/api-key): Step-by-step guide to creating a Claude API
  key, adding credit, and setting a spend cap.
- [/privacy](/privacy): How your API key and answers are handled — no servers,
  no accounts, nothing stored off your device.
- [/terms](/terms): Terms of use for the software.

## Blog

- [/blog](/blog): Index of all posts. RSS feed at [/rss.xml](/rss.xml).
- [/blog/one-euro-ai-campaign](/blog/one-euro-ai-campaign): Full token math for
  a real Kampa run that cost under €0.50, broken down by model call.
- [/blog/marketing-plan-500-budget](/blog/marketing-plan-500-budget): A
  concrete channel and spend split for a €500/month small business budget,
  including which channels to skip.
- [/blog/free-jasper-alternative](/blog/free-jasper-alternative): Why Kampa is
  a free alternative to Jasper (about €59 to €69 per seat monthly), and what
  bring-your-own-key means for your data.
- [/blog/claude-api-key-spend-cap](/blog/claude-api-key-spend-cap): Five steps
  to create a Claude API key and cap monthly spend in the Anthropic console.
- [/blog/facebook-vs-instagram-latvia](/blog/facebook-vs-instagram-latvia):
  Which of the two actually reaches customers in Latvia, and what a €35 boost
  buys on each.
